description: This file defines the OpenIdClientService class, which implements IOpenIdClientService. It manages OpenID Connect client settings, including loading, updating, and validating settings within OrchardCore's OpenId module.

classes.name: OpenIdClientService
classes.description: Service class for managing OpenID Connect client settings, including retrieval, update, and validation within OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current OpenIdClientSettings from the site service.

methods.name: LoadSettingsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and returns the OpenIdClientSettings from site settings.

methods.name: UpdateSettingsAsync
methods.description: Updates the site settings with new OpenIdClientSettings, after null check.

methods.name: ValidateSettingsAsync
methods.description: Validates the provided OpenIdClientSettings, returning validation results asynchronously.
